document_title: Legal Metrology Act, 2009 & Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011
authority: Department of Legal Metrology (Uttar Pradesh / Central)
source_name: National Single Window System (NSWS) / Legal Metrology
disclaimer: DEMO / SYNTHETIC — NOT OFFICIAL REGULATORY TEXT (Curated for SIH 2026 Prototype)

sections.title: Approval of Model and Registration of Packaged Commodities
sections.text: Every person who manufactures or packs any commodity for sale, distribution or delivery in packaged form shall make an application with the Director or Controller of Legal Metrology for registration of the pre-packaged commodity and packaging unit premises.

sections.title: Registration of Manufacturers and Packers
sections.text: Every manufacturer, packer or importer of pre-packaged commodities shall apply for registration within ninety days of commencement of pre-packing activities, submitting specimen package labels containing mandatory declarations (MRP, Net Weight/Volume, Batch No., Manufacturing Date, Customer Care Contact).
